decisions.decision: Applicant was advised that renting the garage bays to outside vendors would require those vendors and/or tenants to come before the Zoning Board for approval, and that the conditions of the special permit issued and modified in April 2012 remain in effect.
decisions.quote: mr. kelly was apprised of the fact that if he rented the garage bays to outside vendors that they (vendor and or tenants) would need to come before the zoning board for approval

decisions.decision: Applicant was informed that, if the petition were granted, a development plan review by the Planning Board would also be required; applicant acknowledged notice.
decisions.quote: mr. beal informed mr. kelly that if the petition were granted a development plan review by the planning board would also be required.
